item.description:
Kiku for Mac 1.0 (309): the native Mac app, delivered directly with signed automatic updates (no more TestFlight on Mac).
- Native Mac Catalyst app signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and updated through Kiku's Sparkle feed. - Margin "Continue in Kiku" > Save & Open now brings Kiku to the front on the Mac. - Page cleanup (skipping page numbers and other page furniture) works again: the AI model it relied on was retired upstream, so it has been moved to a supported one. - Library search on the Mac uses the Mac search field (no focus-system crash). - Includes every fix through TestFlight build 307, including recovery for PDFs with damaged ligature text.
